subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.

She has _____ (witty) remarks about everything.
solution:
The correct answer is '**unamusing**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**unamusing**" (मज़ेदार नहीं) means not entertaining or humorous.
 
• The word "**witty**" (मज़ाकिया) means showing quick and inventive verbal humor.
 
• Therefore, "**unamusing**" is the most appropriate antonym for "**witty**".

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *She has unamusing__ remarks about everything.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sorry ****(माफ़ करना)****:** means feeling distress, especially through sympathy with someone else's misfortune.
 
• **Whimsical (**सनकी): means playfully quaint or fanciful, especially in an appealing and amusing way.
 
• **Woeful (**खस्ताहाल**)**: means characterized by, expressive of, or causing sorrow or misery.

30:Tc34,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
